verdict.rationale: Sill's own Remote Access feature lets you use your Mac away from home through your own VPN (e.g. Tailscale) or a port forwarded on your router. Away from home it starts at a quality a slower link can carry and moves back to the local network automatically, and every connection is encrypted and limited to paired devices. There is no relay, since Sill has no server. Missing for 10: step-by-step setup docs for the VPN and port-forward paths (ports, router configuration), and independent or hands-on confirmation that remote access works.
